manaNeeded: {B/P}, plus an additional {1} available for each omen counter on Celestial Convergence beyond the first
notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Celestial Convergence triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hex Parasite by paying {B/P} plus {1} for each omen counter on Celestial Convergence beyond the first, removing all but one omen counter from Celestial Convergence.
Resolve the Celestial Convergence trigger, removing an omen counter from it and causing you to win the game.
